kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أغتسل (form VIII)
# أَغْتَسِلُ (ʔaḡtasilu) /ʔaɣ.ta.si.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
# أَغْتَسِلَ (ʔaḡtasila) /ʔaɣ.ta.si.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
# أَغْتَسِلْ (ʔaḡtasil) /ʔaɣ.ta.sil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
